name: Broadcast Camera
description: A broadcast camera's tone chain: exposure and white balance in linear light, then black level, gamma, contrast, a colour-keeping highlight knee and saturation on the camera signal. An optional auto mode meters the picture and eases the knee and the blacks towards bright-and-contrasty or flat-and-overcast scenes.

params.label: Exposure
params.doc: Exposure in stops; 0 leaves it as it is.

params.label: Temperature
params.doc: A gentle white balance shift: negative is cooler, positive is warmer.

params.label: Tint
params.doc: A gentle shift between green (negative) and magenta (positive).

params.label: Pedestal
params.doc: Lifts the black floor while white stays white; 0 is none.

params.label: Black stretch
params.doc: Contrast near black: positive deepens and separates the shadows, negative opens them up.

params.label: Gamma
params.doc: The camera curve's gamma: above 1 brightens the midtones, below 1 darkens them; 1 leaves them as they are.

params.label: Contrast
params.doc: Contrast around mid grey; 1 leaves it as it is.

params.label: Knee point
params.doc: The signal level above which highlights start to compress; 1 turns the knee off.

params.label: Knee slope
params.doc: How much of the highlight gain is left at the knee point: 1 does not compress, lower rolls the highlights off harder.

params.label: White clip
params.doc: The level the compressed highlights approach and never pass, in linear light where 1 is SDR white.

params.label: Knee saturation
params.doc: How much colour the compressed highlights keep: 1 keeps their hue and colour, 0 turns them towards grey, 2 pushes them further.

params.label: Saturation
params.doc: The picture's colour, from grey at 0 to the picture's own at 1.

params.label: Auto strength
params.doc: How far the automatic knee and blacks take over from the fixed values: bright, contrasty scenes lower the knee and deepen the blacks, flat, overcast ones raise the knee and lift the blacks; 0 is fixed.

params.label: Auto speed
params.doc: The time in seconds the automatic knee and blacks take to follow a change in the scene.

params.label: View
params.doc: Normal shows the picture; meter adds bars for the metered brightness, contrast, highlight share and the automatic push.
